text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ideas for a new flower arrangement... So, 
you want to change things up from the 
usual style, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about something like a Japanese 
flower arrangement? Kind of like a single 
flower in a vase. Standing straight with a 
strong core, don't you think that'd be 
nice?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I see... Limiting the number of flowers— 
and capturing the feelings—you most want 
to convey... Just like the concept of 
wabi-sabi, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Indeed—it seems we can give it a 
different charm—from the usual 
arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Then going in the exact opposite 
direction, how about super-sizing it? A 
full one-mile-long mega flower 
arrangement!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Does that even fall under the realm\nof 
flower arrangement anymore?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If it's on that large of a scale, we can 
use tons of flowers! Walking through it 
will give everyone so much energy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. A very spacious place—is necessary, 
isn't it? It seems well suited for 
delivering big feelings and— a message to 
a great many people.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, for example――a racecourse...! That's 
a wonderful idea. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's lovely and full of dreams. 
However... it's a huge project in terms of 
both manpower and budget, so getting it 
approved is gonna be quite the chore.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible right now. But—someday. 
Expressing your thoughts and 
wishes—through flowers... To me, nothing 
could seem more wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, I can't wait!\nBouquet-san's giant 
flower arrangement!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. May I one day—create an arrangement— 
that can bring happiness—to people all 
over the world.
